product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone and voice-agent platform that helps sales and support teams at small and mid-sized businesses manage calls, automate conversations, and analyze customer interactions.

employee_band.notes: The company story and careers pages say 200+ employees; its company profile reports 231. An explainer contains a conflicting older estimate of roughly 180.

hq_location.notes: The contact page labels Toronto “Canada HQ”; the company profile also identifies Toronto as headquarters. A product explainer instead describes Bratislava as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Josef Lapka’s R&D posts describe testing infrastructure and implementation of the Bullhorn integration.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current hiring snapshot lists no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. Product Builder involves LLM work but does not meet the requested title criterion. The AI Researcher listing is explicitly marked removed on May 8, 2026; another archived listing also says it is no longer accepting applications.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; ElevenLabs; Deepgram; Google; AssemblyAI; Anthropic
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list identifies these providers for conversation intelligence, voice agents, speech-to-text, or AI Voice Agent configuration; it does not specify production model versions.

compliance_certs.notes: Publicly claimed frameworks: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022; HIPAA and GDPR compliance. PCI DSS is specifically SAQ A 4.0 self-assessment, not a claim of a full third-party PCI audit. HIPAA is supported through a BAA.

last_funding.notes: USD headline amount announced for the round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was January 2024, before the May 9, 2025 start of the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative - Inbound posting in Barcelona.

launched_6mo.notes: The rebuilt AI Sales Dialer became available September 28, 2026, and was publicly announced November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tomas Sakal’s profile dates his VP Customer Experience role at CloudTalk January–December 2025, establishing a VP departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is explicitly named as the CRM used in the SDR job. Other systems are named integration signals, not proof that CloudTalk uses each internally.
